name: MAHESH BHUPATHI
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A powerful baseline player with a dominant serve and exceptional net play, thriving in doubles.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #217 (February 2, 1998), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #1 (April 26, 1999).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Reached the first round of multiple Grand Slams, with limited singles focus.
Grand Slam Achievements: Winner of 12 Grand Slam titles (4 men’s doubles, 8 mixed doubles), including the 1999 French Open men’s doubles with Leander Paes and a career Grand Slam in mixed doubles.
Notable Achievements: First Indian Grand Slam Winner: Won the 1997 French Open mixed doubles with Rika Hiraki. ATP Titles: Secured 52 doubles titles. Davis Cup & National Representation: Represented India in Davis Cup from 1995 to 2011, key to several victories.
Other Highlights: Known for his partnership with Leander Paes as the ‘Indian Express’ duo. Founded the International Premier Tennis League (IPTL) post-retirement.
Bhupathi retired in 2013, leaving a monumental mark on Indian tennis as one of the world’s top doubles players. 🎾🇮🇳
